caption: The drawing depicts a kneeling figure holding a large goblet or chalice in the left hand and a tall, ornate vessel with a pointed lid in the raised right hand. The figure has dark brown to black skin and is dressed in an elaborate costume. The outfit includes a yellow and blue striped turban with white accents, a yellow robe with blue and black patterned details and circular motifs, and blue and white horizontal striped pants or leg coverings. The figure’s feet rest on a rectangular base with light brown and reddish tones. The figure wears a red collar or necklace and is adorned with additional detailing on the headpiece and garments, rendered with brushstrokes of blue, gold, red, and white. Surrounding the central figure on the paper are sketches and color swatches, including snippets of patterns, handwritten notes, and stylized designs with similar color schemes in red, blue, gold, and tan. The background is plain, allowing the decorated figure and the additional sketches to stand out.
title: Sculpture
